name: pksm-switch2
title: PKSM
author: FlagBrew; Switch 2 port by wowilookgood
description: An unofficial Switch 2 build of PKSM, the Pokemon save manager and editor.
details:
PKSM manages and edits Pokemon saves. This is an unofficial build of PKSM 10.4.0 for a Switch 2 running kaiHEN, not a FlagBrew release.

Data goes to /switch/PKSM. The first launch downloads sprite sheets, so it needs a connection. PKSM backs up a save before it writes; keep your own copy as well.

Report Switch 2 problems in the fork's issues, not to FlagBrew.
